gap: No public campaign combines MICP footing/PLT, controlled degradation, paired c-prime/phi-prime measurement, and localization observation in one dataset.
why_it_matters: This is the only route to direct V5 degraded-footing validation.
risk_control: Do not claim direct V5; use component-calibrated validation and local updating.

gap: No clean public H/B matrix with same soil, same protocol, multiple treated depths, degradation, and repeated footing tests.
why_it_matters: The treated-zone weighting function cannot be a universal experimentally identified H/B law.
risk_control: Use capped H/B screening and require PLT/FEM/limit-analysis calibration for final design.

gap: No direct post-peak degraded-footing localization dataset with DIC/tomography.
why_it_matters: chi_s cannot be calibrated as a physical constant for footings.

gap: Environmental degradation depends on chemistry, hydraulic gradients, temperature, cycles, biology, and exposure history.
why_it_matters: A universal calendar-year degradation rate would overclaim.
risk_control: Use exposure-conditioned lambda_E and Bayesian updating.
